title: Decide: migrate is kernel-only (role keys)
description: Debian keyring test: of Debian's 6 role keys, 3 are drafted as people and 3 conflict (shared email, different names), because is_role_key knows only kernel.org list addresses. Constraint over mechanism: record that git-vouch-migrate ports pgpkeys.git only, rather than adding per-project role rules. Mark to confirm.
